label: portalactualsourcevsruntime
before: The ERechV demands a federal administration portal and a user account set up before the first invoice (§ 4(3) ERechV, https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/erechv/__4.html). A formally faulty invoice is rejected automatically and the sender is told. An invoice that cannot be matched to a user account is rejected without notice (§ 4(4) ERechV). The channels below are from the legacy Guide and from the federal e-invoicing information site named in the ministry's questions and answers page (e-rechnung-bund.de, run by the procurement office of the interior ministry). That site is not an allowed host for this Guide, so it is not linked, and the portal address in the legacy Guide was removed.
after: The ERechV demands a federal administration portal and a user account set up before the first invoice (§ 4(3) ERechV, https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/erechv/__4.html). A formally faulty invoice is rejected automatically and the sender is told. An invoice that cannot be matched to a user account is rejected without notice (§ 4(4) ERechV). The channels below are from the legacy Guide and from the federal e-invoicing information site named in the ministry's questions and answers page (e-rechnung-bund.de, run by the procurement office of the interior ministry). Its current upload and e-mail instructions and its September 2025 consolidation statement were read on 29 October 2026 and are linked in Sources. No user account was opened or invoice submitted.

label: lineformulasource
before: These points describe the data format, not the tax law. The first point is carried over from the legacy Guide and was not checked. The others were checked on 19 September 2026 against KoSIT's XRechnung specification, version 3.0.2 (named, not linked). The specification of the format in use decides.
after: These points describe the data format. The amount datatype and line-net formula are checked against XRechnung 3.0.2 sections 8.1 and 12.5 (PEPPOL-EN16931-R120); the tax-group rule is BR-CO-17. The specification of the format in use decides, and no rounding mode is inferred.

label: DE-L23fullR120formula
before: - **Line-level rounding:** net amount = quantity × unit price, rounded to 2 decimal places
after: - **Line net amount (BT-131):** quantity × (item net price / price-base quantity), plus line charges, less line allowances (PEPPOL-EN16931-R120). Amounts are expressed with two decimal places (section 8.1). Quantity × unit price alone describes only the case with a price-base quantity of one and no line charges or allowances.

label: ordinaryGermancodescope
before: Carried over from the legacy Guide (data format, not checked on an official page), except where a law or KoSIT's specification is named.
after: The following ordinary German invoice categories are checked against the named XRechnung rules and the current bundle’s code list. The list is not an exhaustive method for every foreign VAT system.

label: notgloballyexclusivecodelist
before: - **Tax category codes:** KoSIT's XRechnung specification allows only S (Standard rate), Z (Zero rated goods), E (Exempt from tax), AE (VAT Reverse Charge), K (intra-Community supply), G (export, tax not charged), O (outside scope of tax), and L and M for the Canary Islands and for Ceuta and Melilla. The legacy Guide's code AA for the reduced rate is not in that list. A reduced-rate line carries S with its own rate: rule BR-S-5 asks only that the rate under S be greater than zero
after: - **Tax category codes:** For ordinary German invoices, the codes are S (Standard rate), Z (Zero rated goods), E (Exempt from tax), AE (VAT Reverse Charge), K (intra-Community supply), G (export, tax not charged), O (outside scope of tax), and L and M for the Canary Islands and for Ceuta and Melilla. The current validator also recognises code B under its Italian-only conditions; that foreign method is outside this Guide. The legacy Guide's code AA for the reduced rate is not in that list. A reduced-rate line carries S with its own rate: rule BR-S-5 asks only that the rate under S be greater than zero
